summary: Backlog epic and root, Solution Design, Design System and Operation contract reviews can run as review panels: parallel read-only lens readers declared as validated data in `challenge-review/data/review-panels.json`, merged by root cause, approved only without an open critical or major finding and re-reviewed by lens. A panel replaces the step's single reviewer, including the Solution primary reviewer. The new `review_mode` switch in that file selects the panel or the single reviewer and ships as `single`, so every review runs as before until the switch is promoted. The read-only document readers declare a new `lens` execution tier (Claude `sonnet` at effort `high`, Codex effort `high`), which `single` mode renders as the `high` tier they use today. The backlog review manifest carries a `check` block of compiler facts that panel lens readers take as given.
